question: Will the US government take ownership stakes in any of the top 5 leading US AI companies by Dec 31, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if, strictly after 2026-10-01T18:10:54.054Z and at or before 2027-01-01T05:00:00.000Z, the US federal government formally acquires an ownership stake (equity, warrants, convertible instruments, or equivalent) in one or more of the top 5 leading US AI companies, as confirmed by official government announcements, SEC filings, or credible major news reporting.
- "No": Wins if no such ownership stake is formally acquired by the US federal government in any of the top 5 leading US AI companies within the window strictly after 2026-10-01T18:10:54.054Z and at or before 2027-01-01T05:00:00.000Z.

Clarifications:
- The window for qualifying events is strictly after 2026-10-01T18:10:54.054Z and at or before 2027-01-01T05:00:00.000Z; only ownership stakes formally established within this window count.
- "Top 5 leading US AI companies" refers to the five most prominent US-headquartered AI companies by market influence, valuation, or industry recognition at the time of the event — broadly understood to include companies such as NVIDIA, Microsoft, Alphabet/Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, Amazon, Meta, and xAI, with the specific five determined by the resolver based on credible rankings contemporary to the event.
- "Ownership stake" means a formal equity interest, warrants, convertible notes, or equivalent financial instrument giving the US government a direct ownership position; regulatory approvals, licensing agreements, contracts, grants, or investment by government-affiliated funds (e.g., pension funds) without a direct federal ownership claim do not qualify.
